summary: Aptevo Therapeutics Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a Grant Award Agreement with the Andy Hill Cancer Research Endowment Fund for $1,499,951 in reimbursement-based funding supporting IND-enabling studies for APVO451, a trispecific antibody candidate. The grant requires matching non-state contributions and extends through June 2028. This is not a special-situation transaction but a routine grant agreement; no merger, acquisition, activist campaign, or structural event is involved. The filing reports a material definitive agreement but does not trigger any special-situations category; it is a standard current report on a funding arrangement.
